t: How the Entity Attribute Extractor works (Signature)
title: How the Entity Attribute Extractor works (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Entity Attribute Extractor does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature method builds an attribute ledger per entity: each property (birth date, occupation, location) is a ledger entry with its value, its source span, its extraction pattern, and a deterministic confidence weight. Conflicting values from different documents are kept side by side with their evidence — the ledger never silently overwrites. Slot types are enforced as ledger rules, so a birth date that does not parse is quarantined with its evidence. This is a Signature-authored method, original to Justin Addam Higgins.
provenance: Signature-authored original method by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Property of Justin Addam Higgins.
